title: From sunlight to formate at realistic temperatures and dynamic irradiance: direct photovoltaic–electrochemical CO2 reduction using a Cu2O:S gas diffusion electrode

Solar-driven CO2 reduction to liquid fuels such as formate provides an attractive solution for renewable energy storage. This paper investigates the application of an electrochemical (EC) cell for CO2 reduction...
